settings.heading: A love letter
settings.paragraph_1: Born out of cherished Saturday morning traditions. We also saw pancakes as a beautiful blank canvas. After researching and incorporating healthy food sources into our diets, like calming herb teas and chia-seed enriched smoothies we thought, why not incorporate it into our breakfast plate too?
settings.paragraph_2: Flo's Best original pancake mix is like a love letter in edible form, bringing delight to your table, taking time off your hands, and introducing new flavors to your palate.

settings.text: The base of each Flo's Best mix.

settings.accessibility_label: Why moringa is in every pancake
settings.heading: Moringa is the base.
settings.lead: Moringa is a base in each of our pancakes because the leaves are naturally high in vitamins and minerals. It is not a topping we sprinkle on later. It is in the mix, in every flavor.

settings.title: Customer joy
settings.text: Delight at the table comes first. The mix should feel like a love letter, not a chore.

settings.title: Healthy ingredients
settings.text: Fiber, superfoods, and moringa go into the batter, so the good stuff is in every pancake.

settings.title: Time back
settings.text: The mix takes the measuring off your hands, so Saturday morning stays the easy part.
